reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a crypto-arbitrage offer claiming approximately 7% to 9% profit per round through rotating capital between Binance and 50Trades. It directs viewers to buy Litecoin, register on 50Trades, send Litecoin to an address, exchange it for USDT, and withdraw the proceeds back to Binance. The speaker notes that the spread may vary and advises viewers to verify profitability, and the claimed returns are not independently established as genuine, repeatable, or available to viewers.

citations.quote: Buy Litecoin (LTC) through Binance Register a personal account on the 50Trades Transfer LTC from the Binance to the platform and get LTC at an internal rate Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance
Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!
Currently, LTC is 8% more expensive on this exchange, but the spread may vary.
Nevertheless, always verify the profitability.
we need to send LTC to this address

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker presents the price difference as a condition to check, not a fixed opportunity: the stated 8% spread “may vary,” and viewers are told to “always verify the profitability.” The speaker also says the video will be removed when the strategy is no longer profitable. Those qualifications matter when interpreting the profit claim. A changing exchange spread can make an example profitable at one moment without establishing that the same return is available on every later trade.

citations.quote: Currently, LTC is 8% more expensive on this exchange, but the spread may vary.
Nevertheless, always verify the profitability.
Once the strategy is no longer profitable, I will remove this video from the channel.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The quoted 7–9% figure is forceful, but the opening treats it as though the speaker promises that result independently of market conditions. The speaker expressly says the spread may vary and instructs viewers to verify profitability. The transfer instructions establish what the proposed trade involves; they do not, by themselves, establish that the speaker conceals the possibility of an unfavorable rate.

citations.quote: Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!
Currently, LTC is 8% more expensive on this exchange, but the spread may vary.
Nevertheless, always verify the profitability.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications do not undo the central pitch. The description calls the return “Pure profit” of 7–9% per round and instructs viewers to transfer LTC to 50Trades. Advising viewers to check a variable spread does not substantiate the platform's quoted rate, the claimed completed withdrawals, or the availability of comparable returns to viewers.

citations.quote: Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!
Transfer LTC from the Binance to the platform and get LTC at an internal rate Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance
Nevertheless, always verify the profitability.

opening.argument: Judge, much of this video is a walk-through of exchange operations. The speaker describes choosing the Litecoin/USDT pair, buying LTC, selecting a withdrawal network, and retrieving a USDT deposit address. The sampled screens likewise show a trading interface, an exchange interface, and a Binance transaction-history view. These details give the audience a process to examine rather than merely an invitation to send money on trust. The speaker's claim that the spread can vary leaves the viewer with a calculation to make before acting.

citations.quote: we are on the trade spot tap in the Litecoin USDT trading pair first we enter the amount we want to buy LTC for 10 000 USDT.
Choose the same network as on the exchange, I choose TRC 20. Make sure to select the correct network for your case.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening accurately identifies the proposed route through 50Trades, but a tutorial can describe a route without establishing that its presenter is guaranteeing every viewer's outcome. Here the speaker walks through network selection and warns that choosing the correct network depends on the viewer's case. The cited transfer instruction proves that a transfer is part of the demonstration; it does not settle how to interpret the entire video.

citations.quote: Choose the same network as on the exchange, I choose TRC 20. Make sure to select the correct network for your case.
we need to send LTC to this address

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational detail makes the promotion actionable. The description tells viewers to register on 50Trades, transfer LTC there, exchange it, and withdraw USDT, while advertising 7–9% pure profit per round. Screens showing interfaces can illustrate those steps, but they cannot independently validate the claimed profit or show that viewers will be able to reproduce it.

citations.quote: Register a personal account on the 50Trades Transfer LTC from the Binance to the platform and get LTC at an internal rate Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance
Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!

opening.argument: Judge, the described activity is a sequence of ordinary spot purchases, transfers, currency exchanges, and withdrawals. The proposed endpoint is USDT sent back to Binance, not an instruction to leave funds invested indefinitely. The speaker describes a per-trade exchange rate and a variable spread, rather than a downline payment or a return simply for holding a deposit. The material shows a risky proposition whose advertised profit deserves scrutiny, but its transfer step alone does not establish that withdrawals are blocked or that the receiving service will misappropriate funds.

citations.quote: We make the purchase and see a notification about the order being opened and executed.
Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance
Now we send everything back to Binance to convert it into USD or any other convenient currency in the future.
Currently, LTC is 8% more expensive on this exchange, but the spread may vary.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to sending LTC to an address, but a transfer is also an ordinary step in the exchange-and-withdrawal route the description sets out. Its opening rightly says the claimed returns are not independently established; that uncertainty does not itself establish a blocked withdrawal or dishonest custody. The relevant question is whether the observed material shows more than an unverified, aggressively promoted exchange offer.

citations.quote: we need to send LTC to this address
Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A demonstrated blocked withdrawal is not necessary to recognize the concern. This video urges viewers to transfer LTC to a named external platform as part of a process advertised to yield 7–9% pure profit per round. The speaker's assertion that money arrived is not independent evidence that viewers can withdraw or obtain the advertised return. Describing ordinary exchange steps does not verify the unusually favorable rate on which the pitch depends.

citations.quote: Transfer LTC from the Binance to the platform and get LTC at an internal rate Exchange LTC for USDT through the 50trades exchange Withdraw USDT to Binance
Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!
The money has arrived in our balance, and you can see our profit!
